001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import android.net.Uri;
004import androidx.room.Database;
005import androidx.room.RoomDatabase;
006import androidx.room.TypeConverter;
007import androidx.room.TypeConverters;
008import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
009import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.TrackDao;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.UserDao;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
012import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Track;
013import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
014import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.PinDatabase.Converters;
015import java.time.Instant;
016
017@Database(entities = {Pin.class, Track.class, User.class}, version = PinDatabase.VERSION)
018@TypeConverters(Converters.class)
019public abstract class PinDatabase extends RoomDatabase {
020
021  static final int VERSION = 1;
022  private static final String DATABASE_NAME = "pins";
023
024  public static String getDatabaseName() {
025    return DATABASE_NAME;
026  }
027
028  public abstract PinDao getPinDao();
029
030  public abstract UserDao getUserDao();
031
032  public abstract TrackDao getTrackDao();
033
034  public static class Converters {
035
036    @TypeConverter
037    public static Long fromInstant(Instant value) {
038      return (value != null) ? value.toEpochMilli() : null;
039    }
040
041    @TypeConverter
042    public static Instant fromLong(Long value) {
043      return (value != null) ? Instant.ofEpochMilli(value) : null;
044    }
045
046    @TypeConverter
047    public static String fromUri(Uri value) {
048      return (value != null) ? value.toString() : null;
049    }
050
051    @TypeConverter
052    public static Uri fromString(String value) {
053      return (value != null) ? Uri.parse(value) : null;
054    }
055  }
056
057
058}
